sections.title: Fresno Industry Specializations
sections.description: Deep expertise in Fresno's key verticals — agriculture, food processing, water, and healthcare.

blocks.heading: Agricultural Technology (The Central Valley's AI Core)
paragraphs: The San Joaquin Valley produces almonds (California supplies 80% of world production), grapes (wine and table), stone fruits (peaches, plums, nectarines), tomatoes (California canning tomato capital), and pistachios — all with distinct AI requirements:

Almonds: Bloom timing prediction and pollination logistics ML; yield prediction from bloom count satellite imagery; hull-split timing prediction for optimal harvest scheduling; hull and kernel quality prediction.

Grapes and wine: Viticulture ML for canopy management, irrigation scheduling from soil moisture and ET data; Brix (sugar) prediction from vine sensor and weather data; disease pressure prediction (Botrytis, powdery mildew).

Tomatoes: Yield mapping from combine yield monitor data; processing tomato quality prediction (Brix, color, pH) from harvest sensor data; field-level yield prediction for processing tomato contract management.
Specialty crops: AI applications for California's diverse specialty crop portfolio — pistachio shell stain prediction, citrus packout prediction, fig moisture content optimization.

blocks.heading: Food Processing and Packing
paragraphs: Fresno's food processing industry — Sun-Maid Growers of California (raisin processing, Kingsburg), Del Monte Foods (Fresno operations), and hundreds of packing houses and processors:
Packout quality prediction: ML predicting packout grade distribution (fancy, choice, standard) from incoming fruit visual inspection and sensor data.
Process optimization: ML for drying, pasteurization, and processing parameter optimization to maximize yield and quality while minimizing energy use.
Supply chain and grower relationship management: AI for processing tomato and specialty crop supply prediction and grower contract management.

blocks.heading: Water Management (California's Most Critical Resource)
paragraphs: California's water crisis — drought, groundwater depletion, and agricultural water rights complexity — makes water management AI the highest-urgency AI application in Fresno:
Crop evapotranspiration modeling: ML predicting crop water demand from weather data, soil type, and canopy state for precision irrigation scheduling.
Groundwater basin analytics: ML for aquifer recharge prediction, subsidence risk assessment, and Sustainable Groundwater Management Act (SGMA) compliance analytics.
Water allocation optimization: ML optimizing water application timing and volume across diverse crop portfolios and delivery infrastructure constraints.

blocks.heading: Healthcare
paragraphs: Community Medical Centers (Fresno's largest hospital network), UCSF Fresno, Adventist Health, and Saint Agnes Medical Center. HIPAA-compliant clinical AI for Fresno's health systems with attention to California CMIA and the health needs of Fresno's agricultural workforce.

sections.title: California Agricultural AI Regulatory Context
sections.description: SGMA, CCPA, and CARB requirements shaping Fresno AI design.

blocks.heading: SGMA (Sustainable Groundwater Management Act)
paragraphs: California's groundwater law requires groundwater sustainability plans for high and medium-priority basins — ClickMasters designs Fresno water management AI with SGMA compliance documentation in mind.

blocks.heading: CCPA/CPRA
paragraphs: California consumer privacy requirements apply to Fresno consumer-facing agricultural platforms (farm management apps, consumer direct fruit sales).

blocks.heading: California Air Resources Board (CARB)
paragraphs: Agricultural air quality regulations — particularly for agricultural burning and equipment emissions — create environmental analytics AI requirements for Fresno agricultural operations.
